verdict.rationale: Only indirect community evidence touches this story. One user says Nvidia drivers are their biggest complaint on Fedora, which implies they can be installed but are painful. Another reports Nvidia suspend working on a Fedora spin, and a third cites missing CUDA support as a blocker, so GPU-vendor driver support looks possible but rough. The first-party docs never mention vendor drivers, and nothing anywhere addresses building custom kernel modules. Missing for 10: documented vendor GPU driver installation, documented kernel-module build tooling (e.g. headers/DKMS/akmods), and working CUDA/accelerated-compute support.
